text:
Follow Us! StockTwits Twitter Alphabet Inc (GOOGL) Machine Learning Technology Could Help Medical Research Equipment Advancement 
GOOGL – The tech giant has created a prototype microscope that can detect cancer via machine learning. Corp. News 
Alphabet Inc ( NASDAQ:GOOGL ) continues to make impressive strides in the areas of artificial intelligence and machine learning, and there’s a school of thought that suggests the surface is just now being scratched of what will ultimately be possible. We can add this item to the list that helps to confirm that sentiment. 
9to5 Google passes along yet another impressive stride that has been made by Google. 
Machine learning has the potential to fuel major technological developments in countless fields, with Alphabet’s X division already investigating agriculture and food production usage. A team inside Google is now using it for cancer research and detection with a prototype microscope. 
A team at Google Brain — the company’s AI research division — today presented an in-review paper about detecting cancer using machine learning and a modified microscope that features an augmented reality display. 
AI head Jeff Dean explains that Google’s augmented reality microscope “blend[s] the expertise of automated machine learning systems with human expertise.” To provide even further confirmation of that scratch the surface sentiment, the company acknowledges there may very well be even more fascinating advancements coming down the pike. 
“ARM has potential for a large impact on global health, particularly for the diagnosis of infectious diseases, including tuberculosis and malaria, in developing countries,” the company notes. 
Alphabet Inc Class A shares rose $4.43 (+0.41%) in premarket trading Wednesday. Year-to-date, GOOGL has gained 2.46%, versus a 1.65% rise in the benchmark S&P 500 index during the same period.
